_comment: ATIVE UAS Bot - Node.js with Canvas Support
name: ATIVE UAS Bot
author: support@ative.com
description: ATIVE Utility & Security Bot with Canvas and MySQL support. Handles UAS subdirectory automatically.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ ! -z ${UNNODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install; echo "Rebuilding Canvas for container compatibility..."; /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "Canvas rebuild warning (continuing anyway)"; fi; if [[ "{{DEPLOY_COMMANDS}}" == "1" ]] && [[ -f scripts/deploy-commands.js ]]; then echo "Deploying Discord slash commands..."; /usr/local/bin/node scripts/deploy-commands.js || echo "Command deployment failed (continuing anyway)"; fi; /usr/local/bin/node "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ATIVE UAS Bot Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool

# Install Canvas dependencies
apt install -y libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config

# Install MySQL client for database connectivity
apt install -y default-mysql-client

echo -e "updating npm. please wait..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it's not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

## pull git js repo
if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e ".git directory exists"
        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            echo -e "loading info from git config"
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            echo -e "files found with no git config"
            echo -e "closing out without touching things to not break anything"
            exit 10
        fi
    fi

    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "pulling latest from github"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty.\ncloning files into repo"
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
        echo -e "cloning default branch"
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        echo -e "cloning ${BRANCH}'"
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi

fi

# Check if UAS bot is in a subdirectory and move files
if [ -d "uas" ]; then
    echo "Found UAS bot in 'uas' subdirectory, moving files to root..."
    # Remove conflicting directories first
    rm -rf UTILS COMMANDS scripts logs 2>/dev/null || true
    # Move all files from uas/ to current directory
    cp -r uas/* .
    # Remove uas directory
    rm -rf uas
    echo "UAS files moved to server root"
fi

echo "Installing nodejs packages"
if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "Installing dependencies..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
    echo "Rebuilding Canvas module for container compatibility..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "Canvas rebuild warning (module may need fresh install)"
    echo "Canvas rebuild attempted"
else
    echo "No package.json found, installing common UAS bot dependencies..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm init -y
    /usr/local/bin/npm install discord.js@^14.14.1 mysql2@^3.6.5 winston@^3.11.0 dotenv@^16.3.1 node-cron@^3.0.3 ms@^2.1.3 canvas
fi

# Create necessary directories
mkdir -p logs scripts

# Set up environment template if .env doesn't exist
if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -f .env.example ]; then
    echo "Creating .env from .env.example template"
    cp .env.example .env
fi

echo -e "UAS Bot install complete"
exit 0
